name: GitLab CLI
description: Installs the GitLab CLI (glab) with telemetry disabled by default.

version.description: glab release to install: '1.132.0', 'latest' or another version (a leading 'v' is optional).

telemetry.description: Allow glab usage telemetry. When false, GLAB_SEND_TELEMETRY=false is set for every invocation unless you set it yourself.
